question: Can a shared compatibility map acquired against the retained program contracts unlock a second neural gain from the already improved runtime, while preserving old programs and a fixed recruitment budget?
motivation: P64 completed and independently verified. Guided recruitment512 succeeds in4/6 contexts but all arms fail to add a second retained gain on the prespecified already improved0.6B151003 chain. Of200 deep-chain development candidates,112 improve own quality in both blocks,110 retain reliable old program IDs, only9 preserve the stronger prior quality contract. This follow-up changes compatibility acquisition rather than weakening preservation.
mechanism: Same original pretrained components, local response interfaces, instantaneous residual/sensitivity recruitment, four retained slots and at most two extra native evaluations. Feature control uses paired-feature ridge transport. Contract arm also proposes a single shared raw-affine canonical map fitted to known source input-history task targets evaluated through every unchanged retained program. The objective combines program-output loss, paired-feature anchoring and an identity prior; feature weights0.01/0.1/1 and ridge0.001/0.01 are supplied. Old program weights unchanged. Six numerical map variants per physical candidate plus the feature map; joint feedback chooses execution/interface pair. Interface-only control offers the same map variants on unchanged execution. No claim of label-free transport in this follow-up: numerical target labels enter interface acquisition and their construction/fitting costs are explicit.
boundaries: P64 evidence is development motivation only. New P65 source, feedback, round-fresh and terminal seeds are disjoint. Physical graphs with identical frozen component/connection parameters share exactly the same native exposure within an arm; alternate maps reuse those observations, with all map/program fit costs measured. No sharing of unseen outcomes across arms, stages or inputs. First accepted improvement is guarded against the fixed P63 reference. No prior head is refitted; new assessment heads have matched source exposure on baseline and candidate.
primary: At least one new neural connection is retained after a strict second-gain fresh test and the final controller improves terminal quality >=1percent in both untouched terminal streams while meeting all inherited program/quality contracts. Stronger repeated criterion requires >=2 accepted neural recruitments plus that terminal result. Pure interface-only changes are separately counted, never called new neural recruitment.
stopping: All three arms execute five rounds once; identical retention tests and fallback/rollback policy toP64. Every candidate map, selected/failed pair and terminal result retained. No outcome-driven tuning or exclusions. Engineering exceptions preserve raw data/source and require a new recorded version. Application evaluation remains separate and prospective.
inherited_costs: P63 history, P64 discovery/negative deep-chain work, pool extraction and fidelity are inherited development work. New native execution and CPU map fitting, unused alternatives, maintenance and final validation charged separately.
